0.0.en: Early each morning Leo does one kind [[deed:deed]] to [[accustom:accustom]] himself to waking up early.
0.0.zh: 每天清晨，利奥都会做一件好事，让自己习惯早起。

0.1.en: When the [[alarm:alarm]] rings, he has learned to [[react:react]] fast and [[reflect:reflect]] calmly on yesterday.
0.1.zh: 闹钟一响，他已经学会迅速反应，并冷静地回想昨天。

0.2.en: Leo must [[bear:bear]] the cold morning air and [[adopt:adopt]] a firm plan for the long day.
0.2.zh: 利奥要忍住清晨的寒气，为漫长的一天定下一份坚定的计划。

0.3.en: A warm breakfast [[can:can]] [[nourish:nourish]] his body, while father helps [[mow:mow]] the [[grass:grass]] in front of the house.
0.3.zh: 热乎乎的早餐能滋养他的身体，爸爸则在屋前帮忙修剪草地。

0.4.en: Leo steps [[outside:outside]], [[exhale:exhales]] white breath into the cold air, and checks his daily food [[intake:intake]] plan.
0.4.zh: 利奥走到户外，朝冷空气呼出一团白气，再检查自己每天的饮食摄入计划。

0.5.en: A cup of hot milk [[can:can]] [[revive:revive]] his tired head, so he [[can:can]] [[survive:survive]] the busy morning.
0.5.zh: 一杯热牛奶能让他昏沉的脑袋重新清醒，帮他挺过忙碌的早晨。

1.0.en: The low sun sends a sharp [[glare:glare]], but Leo still catches a quick [[glimpse:glimpse]] of the bus.
1.0.zh: 低低的太阳有些刺眼，但利奥还是很快瞥见了公交车。

1.1.en: He takes a quick [[glance:glance]] at his watch, then has a [[peep:peep]] down the long road between the trees.
1.1.zh: 他飞快地看了一眼手表，又透过树丛朝长路那头偷看了一下。

1.2.en: His [[steady:steady]] [[gaze:gaze]] stays on the road while he tries to [[peer:peer]] through the light morning rain.
1.2.zh: 他目光沉稳地盯着路面，努力透过清晨的小雨张望。

1.3.en: Last evening he had [[contemplate:contemplated]] the stars and [[stare:stared]] long at the [[night:night]] sky.
1.3.zh: 昨晚他还在那儿凝思满天繁星，久久注视着夜空。

1.4.en: There he took an [[oath:oath]] and made a solemn [[vow:vow]] in silence.
1.4.zh: 就在那时，他默默立下誓言，许下一个庄重的誓约。

1.5.en: He added one more [[pledge:pledge]], and somewhere a [[whistler:whistler]] sang softly to the morning.
1.5.zh: 他又添上一份新的承诺，远处不知谁吹着口哨，为清晨轻轻唱着。

2.0.en: Leo quickly [[reply:replies]] to his mother and [[notify:notifies]] his friend about the late bus.
2.0.zh: 利奥马上回复妈妈，又通知朋友公交车晚点了。

2.1.en: He likes to [[assert:assert]] his idea clearly, then [[explain:explain]] the bus [[delay:delay]] calmly.
2.1.zh: 他喜欢清楚地说出自己的想法，再心平气和地解释公交延误的原因。

2.2.en: Two boys start a loud [[quarrel:quarrel]], but the driver stops the small [[dispute:dispute]] at once.
2.2.zh: 两个男孩大声吵了起来，司机立刻止住了这场小纠纷。

2.3.en: After the short [[argument:argument]], Leo must [[hasten:hasten]] on foot to reach the school gate.
2.3.zh: 短短的争论过后，利奥只能加快脚步，步行赶往校门。

2.4.en: A kind [[guard:guard]] seems to [[urge:urge]] him to run, and does not [[scold:scold]] him for being late.
2.4.zh: 一位和善的门卫似乎在催他快跑，并没有因为他迟到而责骂他。

2.5.en: Leo will not [[curse:curse]] his bad luck, nor [[swear:swear]] at the heavy [[traffic:traffic]].
2.5.zh: 利奥不会咒骂坏运气，也不会对着拥堵的车流骂骂咧咧。

3.0.en: A rude shout could [[provoke:provoke]] ire, but the teacher only wishes to [[preach:preach]] patience.
3.0.zh: 粗鲁的喊声本会惹人动气，老师却只想讲讲耐心。

3.1.en: Leo never [[boast:boasts]] about his scores, and never [[tease:teases]] his tired classmates.
3.1.zh: 利奥从不吹嘘自己的分数，也从不戏弄疲惫的同学。

3.2.en: Nobody will [[mock:mock]] his accent, and many friends will [[clap:clap]] for his short speech.
3.2.zh: 没有人会嘲笑他的口音，许多朋友还会为他的简短发言鼓掌。

3.3.en: Classmates loudly [[applaud:applaud]] his effort as he tries to [[catch:catch]] every useful word.
3.3.zh: 同学们为他的努力大声喝彩，他则努力听清每一个有用的单词。

3.4.en: He does not [[snatch:snatch]] other people's books, nor [[grab:grab]] pens from shared desks.
3.4.zh: 他不抢别人的书，也不从共用的书桌上抓走别人的笔。

3.5.en: Leo wants to [[overtake:overtake]] his old self and keep a firm [[grip:grip]] on his daily habits.
3.5.zh: 利奥想超过过去的自己，牢牢把握住自己的日常习惯。

4.0.en: Before class the [[mess:mess]] is cleaned up, and the [[twist:twist]] in the rope is undone.
4.0.zh: 上课前，杂乱被收拾干净，绳子上的扭结也被解开。

4.1.en: Each [[fold:fold]] in the papers is smoothed out, with nothing left to [[scatter:scatter]].
4.1.zh: 纸张的每道折痕都被抚平，再没有会散落一地的东西。

4.2.en: Every [[fasten:fastening]] is checked twice, so nothing is left to [[loosen:loosen]].
4.2.zh: 每一处扣紧的地方都检查过两遍，没有任何会松脱的地方。

4.3.en: No desk will be [[smash:smashed]] in a fit of ire, and no wall [[scratch:scratched]] by an angry pen.
4.3.zh: 没有人一气之下砸烂书桌，也没有谁用笔划坏墙壁。

4.4.en: Mud is [[scrape:scraped]] from the shoes, and the old classroom windows are [[polish:polished]] till they shine.
4.4.zh: 鞋底的泥被刮得干干净净，旧教室的窗户擦得锃亮。

4.5.en: The cleaning tasks are [[split:split]] evenly, while the trees [[sway:sway]] gently [[outside:outside]] the window.
4.5.zh: 清洁任务分得公平，窗外的树木正轻轻摇曳。

5.0.en: His [[phone:phone]] starts to [[vibrate:vibrate]] softly, while [[dust:dust]] seems to [[whirl:whirl]] in the warm light.
5.0.zh: 他的手机开始轻轻振动，灰尘似乎在暖光里打转。

5.1.en: The fan blades [[rotate:rotate]] slowly above, as Leo feels his tired head [[reel:reel]].
5.1.zh: 头顶的扇叶慢慢转动，利奥只觉得昏沉的脑袋晕乎乎的。

5.2.en: At lunchtime students [[shuffle:shuffle]] their feet, but never [[collide:collide]] in the [[narrow:narrow]] hall.
5.2.zh: 午饭时分，学生们拖着脚步走，却在窄窄的走廊里互不相撞。

5.3.en: Leo likes to [[combine:combine]] rice with vegetables and [[integrate:integrate]] [[fruit:fruit]] into his lunch.
5.3.zh: 利奥喜欢把米饭和蔬菜搭配着吃，再把水果也加进午餐。

5.4.en: The smell of good food seems to [[penetrate:penetrate]] the whole hall and [[pierce:pierce]] his sleepy afternoon mood.
5.4.zh: 饭菜的香味仿佛渗透了整个大厅，一下子刺破了他昏昏欲睡的午后心情。

5.5.en: He [[insert:inserts]] his meal card quickly and [[tilt:tilts]] the [[tray:tray]] a little to keep it [[steady:steady]].
5.5.zh: 他迅速插入饭卡，再微微倾斜餐盘，让它端得稳稳的。

6.0.en: After lunch the friends [[tow:tow]] the ball bag together and follow the dusty [[trail:trail]] to the courts.
6.0.zh: 午饭后，朋友们一起拖着球袋，沿着尘土飞扬的小路走向球场。

6.1.en: They help [[arrange:arrange]] the cones in lines and learn to [[manipulate:manipulate]] the ball well.
6.1.zh: 他们帮忙把标志桶摆成一行行，学着熟练地控球。

6.2.en: The coach teaches Leo to [[steer:steer]] his runs, and hot sweat [[baptise:baptises]] his shirt in the sun.
6.2.zh: 教练教利奥掌握跑位，烈日下滚烫的汗水浸透了他的球衣。

6.3.en: Nobody wants to [[bet:bet]] money on the game or put pride at [[stake:stake]] after school.
6.3.zh: 没人想拿比赛赌钱，也没人想在放学后拿自尊冒险。

6.4.en: They will not [[gamble:gamble]] with safety, but only share a fair [[promise:promise]] to play clean.
6.4.zh: 他们不拿安全去冒险，只立下一份堂堂正正打球的公平约定。

6.5.en: Fast games always [[attract:attract]] many students, yet Leo never [[obsess:obsesses]] over the final score.
6.5.zh: 快节奏的比赛总能吸引许多学生，但利奥从不执着于最后的比分。

7.0.en: [[smooth:Smooth]] moves [[can:can]] [[mesmerize:mesmerize]] the young fans, but missing shots feels like a short [[nightmare:nightmare]].
7.0.zh: 流畅的动作能把小球迷们看呆，可投丢的球又像一场短暂的噩梦。

7.1.en: Leo [[can:can]] [[amaze:amaze]] his team with clever passes, and they [[marvel:marvel]] at his quick footwork.
7.1.zh: 利奥能用巧妙的传球惊艳全队，大家惊叹他灵活的脚步。

7.2.en: His high [[jump:jump]] [[can:can]] [[astonish:astonish]] the tall rivals and [[involve:involve]] every friend in loud cheers.
7.2.zh: 他高高的一跃能让高个子对手惊叹，也让每个朋友都加入欢呼。

7.3.en: A bad call may [[annoy:annoy]] the tired players, but it must not [[upset:upset]] their friendly mood.
7.3.zh: 误判可能惹恼疲惫的队员，却不能搅了大家的友好心情。

7.4.en: Strange rules [[can:can]] [[bewilder:bewilder]] new players — that is the small [[irony:irony]] of street games.
7.4.zh: 奇怪的规则常让新手摸不着头脑，这正是街头小球赛的小小讽刺。

7.5.en: Leo hates the [[indignity:indignity]] of cheating and shows [[contempt:contempt]] for rude [[foul:foul]] play.
7.5.zh: 利奥讨厌作弊带来的羞辱，也鄙视粗野的犯规动作。

8.0.en: He shows no [[neglect:neglect]] for the [[training:training]] rules and no [[disregard:disregard]] for the coach's voice.
8.0.zh: 他对训练规则从不含糊，也从不把教练的话当耳旁风。

8.1.en: Playing in [[ignorance:ignorance]] of the rules reveals [[bias:bias]] and often brings needless fouls.
8.1.zh: 不懂规则就上场，显得偏心护短，还常常带来无谓的犯规。

8.2.en: Leo will not [[deviate:deviate]] from fair play, so he never faces orders to [[expel:expel]] him from the court.
8.2.zh: 利奥不会偏离公平竞赛，也就从没被勒令逐出球场。

8.3.en: He will not [[flee:flee]] from strong rivals, nor [[bully:bully]] smaller kids on the [[court:court]].
8.3.zh: 他不会在强手面前逃开，也不欺负球场上比他小的孩子。

8.4.en: The last seconds [[can:can]] bring [[panic:panic]], but loud shouts should never [[terrify:terrify]] the young players.
8.4.zh: 最后几秒难免让人心里发慌，但大声喊叫不该吓坏小队员。

8.5.en: Thoughts of [[revenge:revenge]] for last [[loss:loss]] cannot [[kidnap:kidnap]] his calm and friendly mood.
8.5.zh: 为上一场失利报仇的念头，夺不走他冷静友好的心情。

9.0.en: Nobody [[can:can]] [[hijack:hijack]] the happy game or [[smuggle:smuggle]] bad feelings into the team.
9.0.zh: 没人能劫走这场快乐的比赛，也没人能把坏情绪偷带进队伍。

9.1.en: In the stories they read, fair judges [[convict:convict]] the cheaters, while stress tries to [[strangle:strangle]] the fun.
9.1.zh: 在他们读过的故事里，公正的裁判会判作弊者有罪，而压力总想扼杀快乐。

9.2.en: It was no bloody [[massacre:massacre]] of scores, only a fair [[decimation:decimation]] of old fears.
9.2.zh: 那不是比分上的血腥屠杀，只是一次对旧日恐惧的痛快清算。

9.3.en: The coach may [[intervene:intervene]] to stop fights that [[impede:impede]] their happy games on the court.
9.3.zh: 教练会出面制止那些妨碍大家在球场上开心打球的小冲突。

9.4.en: [[victory:Victory]] has a strong [[allure:allure]], but sweet words are only [[bait:bait]] for heedless young minds.
9.4.zh: 胜利固然诱人，可甜言蜜语只是让懵懂少年上钩的诱饵。

9.5.en: Kind cheers [[can:can]] [[induce:induce]] fresh energy and never [[tempt:tempt]] players toward rude tricks.
9.5.zh: 善意的欢呼能激发新的劲头，绝不会引诱队员去耍花招。

10.0.en: After the games, teachers [[designate:designate]] reading zones and [[assign:assign]] pages for [[night:night]] study.
10.0.zh: 比赛结束后，老师们划出阅读区，布置好夜读的页数。

10.1.en: Helpers [[distribute:distribute]] clean [[worksheet:worksheets]] and quickly [[despatch:despatch]] messages to late teammates.
10.1.zh: 帮手们分发干净的练习纸，还赶紧给迟到的队友捎信提醒。

10.2.en: To [[detach:detach]] the tag means to [[undo:undo]] the small [[knot:knot]] with care.
10.2.zh: 要把标签取下来，就得小心地解开那个小结。

10.3.en: Leo would not [[conceal:conceal]] the truth, nor [[disguise:disguise]] his true feelings.
10.3.zh: 利奥不会隐瞒真相，也不会掩饰自己的真实感受。

10.4.en: No one should [[exclude:exclude]] others, or [[refuse:refuse]] help when it is needed.
10.4.zh: 谁都不该把别人排挤在外，也不该在别人需要时拒绝帮忙。

10.5.en: He would [[assure:assure]] her, and never [[reverse:reverse]] his decision.
10.5.zh: 他会让她安心，也从不推翻自己定下的决定。

11.0.en: Leo will [[undertake:undertake]] extra listening drills that clearly [[stipulate:stipulate]] daily time limits.
11.0.zh: 利奥会承担额外的听力训练，训练里明确规定每天的时间上限。

11.1.en: Good scores [[can:can]] [[convince:convince]] his father and [[reassure:reassure]] his worried family at home.
11.1.zh: 好成绩能说服爸爸，也能安抚家里放心不下的亲人。

11.2.en: Leo learns to [[aspire:aspire]] high and to control wild [[desire:desire]] for games and phones.
11.2.zh: 利奥学着志存高远，控制自己对游戏和手机的疯狂渴望。

11.3.en: He seems to [[yearn:yearn]] for broad knowledge, and often [[invoke:invoke]] great examples from the past.
11.3.zh: 他似乎渴求广博的学识，常引用昔日的伟大榜样来激励自己。

11.4.en: An [[inner:inner]] [[itch:itch]] for [[progress:progress]] drives each new [[attempt:attempt]] at the hard listening tasks.
11.4.zh: 内心对进步的渴望，推着他一次次向困难的听力任务发起尝试。

11.5.en: Leo will [[strive:strive]] each evening and slowly [[fulfil:fulfil]] his weekly study plan.
11.5.zh: 利奥每晚都全力以赴，一步步完成每周的学习计划。

paraZh.0: 清晨闹钟一响，利奥定好计划迎接忙碌一天。
paraZh.1: 晨光中等车，利奥回望昨夜星空与誓言。
paraZh.2: 公交晚点，利奥从容解释，一路跑进校门。
paraZh.3: 课堂谦和专注，利奥靠好习惯超越自己。
paraZh.4: 全班分工打扫教室，窗明几净树影轻摇。
paraZh.5: 饭菜香气唤醒困意，利奥端稳餐盘吃好午饭。
paraZh.6: 午后球场开练，汗水挥洒约定公平打球。
paraZh.7: 球技惊艳众人，利奥也守住友好风度。
paraZh.8: 守规则不欺弱，关键时刻保持冷静友好。
paraZh.9: 赛场无人搅局，欢呼聚起正能量。
paraZh.10: 赛后布置夜读，人人坦诚互助不含糊。
paraZh.11: 利奥承担听力训练，用成绩安抚家人。
